chunks.en: I moved to town in August.
chunks.note: 說自己什麼時候搬來。moved 是 move 的過去式；月份前面用 in。

distractors.text: I moved to town at August.
I moveed to town in August.
I moved to town in the August.

chunks.en: I'd like to find a job here.
accept: I would like to find a job here.
chunks.note: 客氣地說自己想做什麼：I'd like to + 動詞原形。I'd = I would。

distractors.text: I'd like find a job here.
I'd like to find job here.
I'd like to finding a job here.

chunks.en: I worked in an office in Taiwan.
chunks.zh: 我在台灣是坐辦公室的。
chunks.note: 介紹以前的工作。office 開頭是母音，所以用 an，不用 a。

distractors.text: I worked in a office in Taiwan.
I worked in an offices in Taiwan.
I worked in an office at Taiwan.

accept: I am looking for something similar.
chunks.note: look for = 找。similar 放在 something 後面，意思是「差不多的東西」。

distractors.text: I'm looking something similar.
I'm looking for similar something.
I'm look for something similar.

chunks.zh: 我比較想去小一點的公司。
accept: I would prefer a smaller company.
chunks.note: 比較級：短的形容詞加 -er（small → smaller），意思是「比較……」。

distractors.text: I'd prefer a more small company.
I'd prefer a smaler company.
I'd prefer smaller company.

chunks.en: Weekends off would be better for me.
chunks.zh: 週末能休假對我來說比較好。
chunks.note: 比較級：better 是 good 的比較級，不說 gooder，也不說 more better。

distractors.text: Weekends off would be more better for me.
Weekends off would be gooder for me.
Weekends off would better for me.

chunks.en: Is this job full time or part time?
accept: Is this job full-time or part-time?
chunks.note: 看到徵人廣告先問這句。full time 全職、part time 兼職。

distractors.text: Is this job full time or part times?
Does this job full time or part time?
Is job full time or part time?

chunks.en: How do I apply for it?
chunks.note: apply for + 工作 = 應徵這份工作。it 指剛剛說的那份工作。

distractors.text: How I do apply for it?
How do I applying for it?
How do I aply for it?

chunks.zh: 如果是你，你會選哪一個？
chunks.note: 拿不定主意時請對方給意見。would you 是「如果是你，你會……」。

distractors.text: Which one you would choose?
Which one would you to choose?
Which one would you chooses?

chunks.en: Does the office job pay overtime?
chunks.zh: 辦公室那份有加班費嗎？
chunks.note: 問有沒有加班費。主詞 the office job 是一份工作，用 Does，pay 不加 s。

distractors.text: Does the office job pays overtime?
Does office job pay overtime?
Does the office job pay overtine?

chunks.note: 動名詞：enjoy 後面的動詞要加 -ing（enjoy working），不說 enjoy to work。

distractors.text: I enjoy to work with people.
I enjoy work with people.
I enjoy working with peoples.

chunks.en: I decided to apply for the office job.
chunks.zh: 我決定應徵辦公室那份工作。
chunks.note: 不定詞：decide 後面接 to + 動詞原形（decided to apply），不加 -ing。

distractors.text: I decided applying for the office job.
I decided to applied for the office job.
I decided to apply the office job.

chunks.en: What do I need for the application?
chunks.note: 問申請要準備什麼。What do I need for…? = ……需要什麼？

distractors.text: What I need for the application?
What do I needs for the application?
What do I need for the aplication?

chunks.zh: 我明天要帶什麼東西嗎？
chunks.note: 問明天要不要帶東西。問句裡用 anything；should 後面接動詞原形。

distractors.text: Should I to bring anything tomorrow?
Should I brings anything tomorrow?
Should bring I anything tomorrow?

words.zh: 我自己（about myself 關於我自己）
人（people person 喜歡跟人相處的人）
可能的（as soon as possible 盡快）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! I'm Ms. Lopez, the job counselor.
scene.zh: 嗨！我是就業顧問 Lopez。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I moved to town in August.
scene.zh: 我八月搬來這裡的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome to town! I moved here myself, years ago.
scene.zh: 歡迎！我自己也是好幾年前搬來的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like to find a job here.
scene.zh: 我想在這裡找工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Let's start with this form.
scene.zh: 好啊，我們先從這張表開始。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Write your age, the area you live in, and your English level.
scene.zh: 寫上你的年齡、住的地區，還有你的英文程度。

fills.en: She works as an ___ at a big company.
fills.zh: 她在一家大公司當助理。
fills.note: 在公司做的職位：assistant 是助理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, tell me about your work experience.
scene.zh: 那跟我說說你的工作經驗吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I worked in an office in Taiwan.
scene.zh: 我在台灣是坐辦公室的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I see. Your form says you were a clerk.
scene.zh: 了解，你表上寫你以前是職員。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And what kind of job do you want now?
scene.zh: 那你現在想找什麼樣的工作？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm looking for something similar.
scene.zh: 我想找差不多的工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's good, actually. A lot of companies here need assistants.
scene.zh: 那其實剛好。這裡很多公司都在找助理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you want a big company or a small one?
scene.zh: 你想去大公司還是小公司？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd prefer a smaller company.
scene.zh: 我比較想去小一點的公司。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. But the salary could be lower, at least at first.
scene.zh: 可以啊。不過薪水可能會低一點，至少一開始是這樣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And can you work on Saturdays?
scene.zh: 那星期六可以上班嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Weekends off would be better for me.
scene.zh: 週末能休假對我來說比較好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. Quite a few office jobs have weekends off.
scene.zh: 沒問題。週末休假的辦公室工作還不少。

passages.title: Office Assistant at Harbor Trading
lines: Position: full time, Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 5:00
Requires: English and one year of office experience
To apply, see Ms. Lopez at the Job Center.

questions.en: How do you apply for this job?

passages.title: Waiter Wanted at Rosa's Restaurant
lines: No experience required. We teach you!
Come in and ask for Rosa after 2:00.

questions.en: How much experience does this job require?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Look at this ad from Harbor Trading. They need an assistant.
scene.zh: 你看 Harbor Trading 的這則廣告，他們在找助理。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is this job full time or part time?
scene.zh: 這份是全職還是兼職？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Full time, Monday to Friday, nine to five.
scene.zh: 全職，星期一到五，九點到五點。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The position has good benefits, too.
scene.zh: 這個職位的福利也不錯。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How do I apply for it?
scene.zh: 要怎麼應徵？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You apply through me. They require office experience, and you have it.
scene.zh: 透過我應徵就行。他們要求有辦公室經驗，你剛好有。

lines.en: Ms. Lopez, which job pays more?
lines.zh: Lopez 小姐，哪份工作薪水比較高？

lines.en: The restaurant's wage is higher, but it's all evening shifts.
lines.zh: 餐廳的時薪比較高，但全都是晚班。

lines.en: Evenings? What about the office job?
It pays less, but at least it's Monday to Friday.
lines.zh: 錢比較少，但至少是星期一到五上班。

lines.en: Then I want the office job.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, let's compare these two jobs.
scene.zh: 好，我們來比較一下這兩份工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The restaurant pays more, but the shifts are late.
scene.zh: 餐廳錢比較多，可是班都很晚。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does the office job pay overtime?
scene.zh: 辦公室那份有加班費嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, but overtime isn't very common there.
scene.zh: 有，不過那邊不常加班。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which one would you choose?
scene.zh: 如果是你，你會選哪一個？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The office job. And they want to hire someone now.
scene.zh: 辦公室那份。而且他們現在就要找人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, did you decide?
scene.zh: 那你決定了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I decided to apply for the office job.
scene.zh: 我決定應徵辦公室那份工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great choice! Why that one?
scene.zh: 選得好！為什麼選那份？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I enjoy working with people.
scene.zh: 我喜歡跟人打交道。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can tell. You're a people person.
scene.zh: 看得出來，你很喜歡跟人相處。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This could become a great career for you.
scene.zh: 這份工作有機會變成你很好的事業。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I just talked to Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: 我剛跟 Harbor Trading 聯絡過。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They want local candidates, so you have a good chance.
scene.zh: 他們想找本地的應徵者，所以你機會很大。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What do I need for the application?
scene.zh: 申請要準備哪些東西？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A form, and a page about your work experience.
scene.zh: 一張表，再加一頁寫你的工作經驗。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm running a workshop for that tomorrow at ten.
scene.zh: 我明天十點有個工作坊，就是教這個。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I bring anything tomorrow?
scene.zh: 我明天要帶什麼東西嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If possible, write down your old jobs before you come.
scene.zh: 可以的話，來之前先把你以前做過的工作寫下來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! Are you new in town?
scene.zh: 嗨！你剛搬來嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I moved to town in August.
scene.zh: 我八月搬來這裡的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome! What kind of work did you do before?
scene.zh: 歡迎！你以前做什麼工作？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I worked in an office in Taiwan.
scene.zh: 我在台灣是坐辦公室的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. You'll be able to use that experience.
scene.zh: 不錯，那些經驗你用得上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you want a big company this time?
scene.zh: 這次想去大公司嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd prefer a smaller company.
scene.zh: 我比較想去小一點的公司。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, I have two ads. This one is for an office assistant.
scene.zh: 好，我有兩則廣告。這一則是徵辦公室助理。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is this job full time or part time?
scene.zh: 這份是全職還是兼職？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Full time, and the employer offers good benefits.
scene.zh: 全職，而且雇主有提供不錯的福利。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does the office job pay overtime?
scene.zh: 辦公室那份有加班費嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, but employees there don't work much overtime.
scene.zh: 有，不過那邊的員工不太常加班。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The tasks are phone calls, emails, and meeting people.
scene.zh: 工作內容是接電話、回信，還有跟人見面。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I enjoy working with people.
scene.zh: 我喜歡跟人打交道。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then it's a great choice for you.
scene.zh: 那這份工作很適合你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I decided to apply for the office job.
scene.zh: 我決定應徵辦公室那份工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! Come to my workshop tomorrow. We'll do the application.
scene.zh: 太好了！明天來我的工作坊，我們一起寫申請。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I bring anything tomorrow?
scene.zh: 我明天要帶什麼東西嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, just yourself. See you at ten!
scene.zh: 不用，人來就好。十點見！
